raw_execution_api.name: rawExecute
raw_execution_api.calls: Typed.execute | Composition.executeStep | Composition.run according to ir.mode
raw_execution_api.note: rawExecute is the quantified kernel correspondence target. It is not checkIR. Hypothetical Typed.execute success on a stale document is a rawExecute fact only.

raw_theorems.name: rawExecute_typed_ok
raw_theorems.statement: ∀ ir post, ir : DecodedExecution → ir.mode = typed-execute → supported ir → Typed.execute ir.registry ir.store ir.ctx ir.env ir.now ir.request ir.state = .ok post → rawExecute ir = {world := post.state+store, receipt := invoked ir.request (extractEvaluated ir pre), outputs := [], events := [], nextIndex := 0, cursorFailure := none, kernelFailure := none}. This theorem does not project a Report and does not imply Report.accepted.

raw_theorems.name: rawExecute_typed_error
raw_theorems.statement: ∀ ir r, ir : DecodedExecution → ir.mode = typed-execute → supported ir → Typed.execute ... = .error r → rawExecute ir = {world := ir.preState+store, receipt := none, outputs := [], events := [], nextIndex := 0, cursorFailure := none, kernelFailure := kernel r with wrapped Typed.Refusal ctor/payload}. This theorem does not project a Report.

raw_theorems.name: rawExecute_step_ok
raw_theorems.statement: ∀ ir result, ir : DecodedExecution → ir.mode = composition-step → supported ir → Composition.executeStep ... = .ok result → rawExecute ir world/receipt/outputs equal result, events=[], nextIndex=0, cursorFailure=none, kernelFailure=none. Does not project a Report.

raw_theorems.name: rawExecute_step_error
raw_theorems.statement: ∀ ir f, ir : DecodedExecution → ir.mode = composition-step → supported ir → executeStep = .error f → rawExecute ir kernelFailure is the wrapped FailurePath of f ∧ worldEq pre ∧ receipt=none ∧ outputs=[] ∧ events=[] ∧ nextIndex=0 ∧ cursorFailure=none. Does not project a Report.

raw_theorems.name: rawExecute_run_cursor
raw_theorems.statement: ∀ ir, ir : DecodedExecution → ir.mode = composition-run → supported ir → let c := Composition.run ... in rawExecute ir equals {world := c.world, events := c.events, outputs := c.outputs, nextIndex := c.nextIndex, cursorFailure := c.failure mapped to FailurePath, receipt := last successful prefix receipt or none, kernelFailure := mapped c.failure or none}. Does not project a Report.

guarded_report_connections.name: checkIR_source_identity_guard
guarded_report_connections.statement: ∀ cert ir, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir : DecodedExecution → ¬ source_identity(ir) → (checkIR ir).status = .refused ∧ (checkIR ir).failure = staleSource.git ∧ worldEq (checkIR ir).world ir.preState+store ∧ (checkIR ir).receipt = none ∧ execution families typeCorrect/footprintCorrect/authorityCorrect/accountingCorrect = not_reached ∧ Typed.execute / executeStep / run are not called. F25/F36/F37/F41 may share an identical kernel payload; F37 is this case. Hypothetical rawExecute success is not a checkIR observation.

guarded_report_connections.name: checkIR_from_raw_typed_ok
guarded_report_connections.statement: ∀ cert ir post, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir : DecodedExecution → ir.mode = typed-execute → source_identity(ir) → Typed.execute ... = .ok post → kernel fields of checkIR ir equal rawExecute ir (worldEq post state+store, receipt invoked). This does not imply (checkIR ir).status = .accepted.

guarded_report_connections.name: checkIR_from_raw_typed_error
guarded_report_connections.statement: ∀ cert ir r, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir : DecodedExecution → ir.mode = typed-execute → source_identity(ir) → Typed.execute ... = .error r → (checkIR ir).failure = kernel r with wrapped ctor/payload ∧ worldEq (checkIR ir).world ir.preState+store ∧ (checkIR ir).receipt = none. This implication is false without source_identity; a stale report cannot carry kernel failure r merely because a hypothetical execution would return r.

guarded_report_connections.name: checkIR_from_raw_step_ok
guarded_report_connections.statement: ∀ cert ir result, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir : DecodedExecution → ir.mode = composition-step → source_identity(ir) → Composition.executeStep ... = .ok result → kernel fields of checkIR ir equal rawExecute ir (world, receipt, outputs). Does not imply Report.accepted.

guarded_report_connections.name: checkIR_from_raw_step_error
guarded_report_connections.statement: ∀ cert ir f, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir : DecodedExecution → ir.mode = composition-step → source_identity(ir) → executeStep = .error f → (checkIR ir).failure is the wrapped FailurePath of f ∧ worldEq pre ∧ receipt=none ∧ outputs=[]. Without source_identity this conclusion is not drawn.

guarded_report_connections.name: checkIR_from_raw_run_cursor
guarded_report_connections.statement: ∀ cert ir, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir : DecodedExecution → ir.mode = composition-run → source_identity(ir) → kernel fields of checkIR ir equal rawExecute ir (world, events, outputs, nextIndex, cursorFailure, receipt). Report.status, judgments, assumptions, outstanding, source_pin, audit_roots and unsupported remain report-only policy fields. Without source_identity, F37-style staleSource applies and Composition.run is not called.

full_correspondence_contract.supported_ir_domain: DecodedExecution values for which decodeBytes succeeds, types enumerations are nonempty finite, state table is complete |domains|×|parties|×|assets| nonnegative cells in declaration order, registry ids unique, and step tags are invoke|issue|revoke
full_correspondence_contract.canonicality_hypothesis: RatEnc lowest terms den>0; objects use grammar canonical_nested_key_order plus lexicographic UTF-8 fallback; compact UTF-8 with no extra whitespace; no duplicate keys
full_correspondence_contract.extensional_finite_world_equality: worldEq cells amounts and store.entries pointwise; not function extensionality over an infinite Domain

kernel_versus_report_policy.rule: rawExecute correspondence does not imply Report.status. checkIR is a conditional report projection of rawExecute after prior guards. Do not assume the desired Report constructor from kernel success.
policy_premises_in_order: source_identity: envelope source_pin.git/lean_toolchain/mathlib_rev equal delivered dependency records at D
six_class_presence: all six assumption classes present and labelled
claimed_world_agreement: claimed_next_state is null or worldEq the recomputed post ExecutionResultEnc
kernel_versus_report_policy.recorded_compiler_check: source_pin.compiler_record is some object naming the requested libraries or invariants, with compiler exit 0 and a nonempty theorem inventory; absent/null/mismatched records do not discharge
precedence: decodeBytes codec malformed/blocked never reach kernel or Report
mode routing: only DecodedExecution is a checkIR or rawExecute input
source_identity mismatch: staleSource; kernel not invoked; rawExecute is not used as the report kernel projection; world is pre; receipt is null; execution families not_reached
claimed_world_agreement: on rawExecute ok, mismatch is observationMismatch.claimedNextState; world and receipt are the successful recomputation
six_class_presence: missing required class is incompleteObligation; world/receipt retain the kernel result
requested_discharge_ok: require_library_discharge or require_invariant_discharge without recorded_compiler_check is incompleteObligation; world/receipt retain the kernel result
Report.accepted only if rawExecute ok and source_identity and six_class_presence and claimed_world_agreement and requested_discharge_ok and unsupported is null and required reached families are true
kernel_versus_report_policy.does_not_discharge_P20: Quantified proofs of the statements below remain P20. Finite F25/F36/F37/F41/F27/F28 checks are bounded evidence only.

raw_run_cursor: receipt last successful prefix or null
projections.located_failure: cursorFailure = {index, step (null at startCursor configuration else the refused Step), reason: FailurePath}

statements.name: encode_decode_roundtrip
statements.statement: ∀ (ir : DecodedIR), supported ir → canonical ir → decodeBytes (encodeModule ir) = .ok ir

statements.name: decode_encode_canonical_bytes
statements.statement: ∀ raw ir, decodeBytes raw = .ok ir → canonical ir → encodeModule ir = raw. Decode accepts exactly the compact canonical form (declared nested key order, lexicographic UTF-8 fallback, no extra whitespace). Non-canonical key order or extra whitespace is DecodeFailure, not a second accepted representative.

statements.name: checkIR_report_accepted_from_raw_and_policy
statements.statement: ∀ cert ir post, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir : DecodedExecution → source_identity(ir) → rawExecute ir is a success observation with worldEq post → six_class_presence(ir) → claimed_world_agreement(ir, post) → requested_discharge_ok(ir) → unsupported ir = none → required reached families true → (checkIR ir).status = .accepted ∧ worldEq (checkIR ir).world post. requested_discharge_ok(ir) := (¬ ir.require_library_discharge ∨ recorded_library_compiler_check ir) ∧ (¬ ir.require_invariant_discharge ∨ recorded_invariant_compiler_check ir). Each conjunct is an explicit premise. Kernel success, or any proper subset of these premises, does not imply Report.accepted.

stage_order_typed_execute: guard (prior class; not a family; Evaluated.guard is not accountingCorrect)
contract.combine_one_command: Family F is false if any reached F-stage failed. Family F is not_reached if zero F-stages were reached. Family F is not_applicable if the command kind never has F. Family F is true if at least one F-stage was reached, every reached F-stage succeeded, and unreached later F-stages are not evaluated merely to fill an outcome. Prior-class checks (template.evaluate, guard) are not family stages and do not make accountingCorrect true.
contract.combine_run: Walk attempts in order. A later inert suffix is not evaluated. Family F is false if any reached attempt's F is false. Successful-prefix true does not justify a later failed attempt's conjunct (F49 insufficientFunds makes accountingCorrect false). compositionCompatible remains true when catalog/run machinery ran and the failure is a kernel family.
contract.insufficientFunds_family: accountingCorrect (nonnegative post-balance conjunct). Do not call accountingOK after that failure.
contract.guard_family: none. Guard remains before footprint in execute order. F17/F18 reach a true guard then footprint refusal; accountingCorrect stays not_reached because accountingOK and nonnegative were not reached.
contract.evaluation_missingObservation_family: prior class after invoke; typeCorrect is Args.check (true if that passed); authorityCorrect true if invoke passed; footprint/accounting not_reached

staged_accounting.complete_refused: decode ok, unsupported null, observed FailurePath equals entrypoint error, families whose stages were reached before the failure and succeeded are true, the failing family is false if the failure is a family stage, or the failure is a prior class (template.evaluate or guard) with later families not_reached; this IS a complete checked report, not an accepted module

fixture.name: success prefix then insufficientFunds then inert

planning_interpretations: recorded compiler predicates consume the exact matching external candidate/compiler/audit records required by audit.identity_split; certificate-supplied strings/exit claims alone do not discharge
T-checkIR typed/step error conclusions govern kernel refusal after source identity; successful-execution policy checks cannot replace these error constructors
